title: Mermaid Bungalow | KEY.co
description_expanded: Immerse yourself in coastal elegance at this stunning 30A four-bedroom beach house, a pet-friendly haven designed for unforgettable family vacations. The spacious, fully equipped kitchen with a breakfast bar flows seamlessly into a large living area featuring a state-of-the-art smart TV, perfect for gathering and relaxation. Two main bedrooms, each with king beds, TVs, and en suite bathrooms, offer private retreats on both the main and upper levels. Additional sleeping arrangements include two queen bedrooms, a cozy bunk area with full beds, and ample space to accommodate up to twelve guests. Step outside to enjoy the serene front porch or one of the two inviting balconies, ideal for soaking up the coastal atmosphere. With a golf cart included for convenient beachside exploration, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and parking for three cars plus the golf cart, every detail is designed to enhance your stay. The house’s prime location on the beach side of 30A offers easy access to pristine sands and vibrant local attractions. This beach house promises a luxurious and memorable getaway where every comfort is thoughtfully provided.
